context: A citizen applies for a benefit at the ward office counter
purpose: Process an application; teach 番号/審査/事項/承知/ご覧/お答え

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 受付番号をお持ちですか？
lines.en: Do you have your reception number?
lines.style: polite official beginning the procedure, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: はい、こちらの番号です。
lines.style: cooperative citizen handing over the slip

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: では審査の流れをご説明します。
lines.en: Then I will explain the screening process.
lines.style: measured official walking through the steps

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 審査にはどれくらいかかりますか？
lines.en: How long does the screening take?
lines.style: mildly anxious applicant asking about time

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: この用紙の記入事項をご覧ください。
lines.en: Please look at the items to fill in on this form.
lines.style: guiding official directing attention to the form

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 記入事項が多いですね。承知しました。
lines.en: There are a lot of items. Understood.
lines.style: slightly daunted but compliant citizen, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: ご不明な点はこちらでお答えします。
lines.en: I will answer any unclear points here.
lines.style: reassuring official offering support, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: では一つお答えいただけますか？
lines.en: Then could you answer one question?
lines.style: polite citizen seizing the offer to ask

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: もちろん、承知しました。
lines.style: accommodating official ready to help, each word carrying genuine natural feeling
